{{Top}}
[[File:Koong_drone.jpg|thumb|right|One of Koong's drones]]
A '''drone''' was an unmanned [[Airspeeder/Legends|aircraft]]. [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]] of [[Tawntoom]] Province on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] used drones to attack his enemies. In one [[Skirmish on the Roon Sea|skirmish]], Koong sent a pair of drones after the escaped [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] [[Mungo Baobab]], [[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren Yomm]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[Lin-D]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who had fled in a [[lifeboat]]. Although the drones destroyed the lifeboat's [[Engine/Legends|motor]] and sail, incapacitating Lin-D in the process, Baobab shot them down with the boat's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]].
